purpose: Teach: 特区/能率/退席/実演/私見/既成/中長期/振替

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 特区への進出を社内提案しましょう
lines.en: Let's propose the special economic zone expansion to the company.
lines.style: Brisk, decisive opening. Forward momentum without hesitation. A suggestion framed as collaborative direction. Steady eye contact, clear intent.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。能率の良い作業フローを構築中です
lines.en: Yes. We're building out an efficient workflow system right now.
lines.style: Cooperative confirmation with a brief status update. Light, engaged tone. Shows he's already moving on the task. Not defensive, just informative.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会議中の退席は事前に申請してもらいましょう
lines.en: One thing though—people need to submit requests if they're leaving meetings early.
lines.style: Shift to procedural concern, gentle but firm. Not lecturing. A practical note added thoughtfully, like she's just remembered something that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。展示会で実演ブースを設けました
lines.en: Understood. We've set up a demo booth for the trade show.
lines.style: Quick, efficient update. Acknowledges the previous point without dwelling. Moving forward with tangible progress. Straightforward delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 私見ですが、ブランド変更は時期尚早ですね
lines.en: Speaking personally, I think rebranding right now would be premature.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Careful framing—she's offering opinion, not decree. Slightly uncertain tone, testing the idea aloud. Inviting pushback.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。既成のメニューも見直しましょう
lines.en: Right. Let's also review the existing menu options.
lines.style: Quick agreement and pivot to the next action item. Efficient, collaborative tone. He's absorbed the feedback and moving the conversation forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中長期戦略を経営陣と共有しましょう
lines.en: We should share our medium and long-term strategy with the executive team.
lines.style: Decisive direction, slightly higher stakes than before. Calm but purposeful. Speaking to something important without urgency or drama.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。家賃の振替先を確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the new account for the rent transfers.
lines.style: Final confirmation, settling the last detail. Satisfied tone—task complete. Straightforward, no elaboration needed. Closes the conversation.
